run_lammps_with_fairchem: run a LAMMPS simulation using a FairChem MLIP predictor with a given input script path
create_atomic_data_from_lammps: create an AtomicData object from LAMMPS atom positions, atomic numbers, cell, and periodicity data
lookup_atomic_number_by_mass: lookup atomic numbers by matching closest atomic masses from an array of mass values
separate_run_commands: separate LAMMPS run commands from the rest of an input script into two lists
check_input_script: check a LAMMPS input script for force field commands that may conflict with MLIP forces
